summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WorkRobo.ai SaaS platform. Frontend navigation, UI, and protected routes work correctly. Backend API health endpoints functional. Critical auth integration mismatch identified between frontend (Supabase client) and backend (custom auth endpoints).

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 400 'Email address is invalid' for valid email formats
critical_bugs.root_cause: Backend auth endpoints not aligned with frontend Supabase client usage

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 401 'Invalid credentials' for any login attempt
critical_bugs.root_cause: Backend expects direct auth handling but frontend uses Supabase client

design_issues.issue: Frontend uses Supabase client-side auth but backend has unused custom auth endpoints
design_issues.impact: Auth flow confusion and unused backend code

integration_issues.issue: Console error: 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read'
integration_issues.root_cause: API response handling issue in auth flow

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix authentication architecture mismatch. Frontend uses Supabase client-side auth but backend has custom auth endpoints that don't work. Either: 1) Remove backend auth endpoints and use only Supabase token verification, or 2) Update frontend to use backend auth endpoints. Also fix frontend auth response handling error.
